fusions.name: Winding Sheet
fusions.desc: Winds a close weave around a target at or below 30% health, dealing 18 damage and using up every affliction on it to add 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit.

fusions.name: Smothering Fold
fusions.desc: Throws a drape of close weave across a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it, with a 40% chance per hit to leave it [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gauze Wrap
fusions.desc: Binds your wounds in an open-weave gauze: you regain 3 health a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Warp and Weft
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a row of weave builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per row (35% at full). Unfed, a row fades every 10 seconds.
